*261. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of LAW
AND JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are preparing
any strategies for providing legal aid
including short-term measures such as
helping people getting access to courts and
expeditious disposal of cases through
alternative dispute resolution mechanisms
and long-term measures, including
implementation of the social welfare
schemes envisaged by the legislature and
the executive;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

Ministry is preparing a Bill to introduce

Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the target
for appointment of ten lakh teachers for
the students of class I to VIII was set in
the Tenth Five Year Plan;

far, State-wise; and
(c) if no appointments have been made
so far, the reasons therefor and by when
the said appointments would be made?
Students opting for Science and
Technology

SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the percentage of students
opting for Science and Technology had
shown a sharp decline from 1950 to 2005;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) how it is comparable with the world
figure; and

(d) the concrete measures to check this
downslide?

Will the Minister of INFORMATION
AND BROADCASTING be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Doordarshan sells video
coverage of cricket matches during its
telecast to various news channels;
(b) if so, the amount received by
Government on this account;
(c) whether some channels are yet to
pay this amount to Government; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard?

JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of URBAN

(a) whether it is a fact that Delhi
Development Authority had introduced
Festival Housing Scheme;
(b) if so, the number of houses proposed
to be allotted under this scheme;

Master Plan-2021

CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the status of preparation of the

accordance with the new Master Plan for
Delhi-2021;

Zonal Plans have been finalized;

Delhi-(Zone G) takes into account the
proposals of the "Influence Zone" along
MRTS for the Barakhamba-Dwarka line;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

children
†*267. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are running the schemes for the welfare of
women and children;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount disbursed under
such schemes during the Tenth Five Year
Plan?
Internet connection in schools and
colleges
*268. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to provide high-speed internet connection
to various schools and colleges in every
district;
(b) if so, the details thereof;

Karamcharis

Will the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE
AND EMPOWERMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have received
any recommendations of the National

the blanket ban imposed on recruitment of

(c) the other recommendations made by
the above commission; and
(d) Government's reaction thereto?
Distorted presentation of Jain
Religion
†*270. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether complaints have been
received by NCERT regarding distorted
presentation of Jain Religion in the history
text book "Pracheen Bharat" prescribed for
class XI;

and
(c) if no action has been taken so far,
the reasons therefor?
Duty on registration of residential
units
*271. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of URBAN EMPLOYMENT
AND POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any policy has been
formulated to fix a uniform rate of duty for
registration of residential units throughout
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken against the States
imposing a considerably higher percentage
of duty on property registration?
Reservation in IITs
*272. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
about 4000 seats available in various Indian
Institutes of Technology all over the
country;
(b) the system of reservation for these
4000 seats, category-wise;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
increase the intake by 5 per cent this year;
and
(d) the details of Government's plans
to make better and optimum use of the
vast buildings and equipments at various
IITs?

84

Marriageable age of girls
*273. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) Government's reaction to the
judgment of the Delhi High Court declaring
legality of the marriageable age of 15 years
of girls;
(b) what is the present provision for
marriageable age of a boy and a girl;
(c) the likely social consequences, health
scenario and population problems as a
result thereof; and
(d) the steps Government propose to
take in this regard?
Implementation of schemes in Goa
*274. SHRI SHANTARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the existing schemes of his Ministry
in force in the country;
(b) the schemes in force in Goa; and
(c) the financial assistance given to the
State Government for various schemes
during the last five years?
Review of DTH TV channel
*275. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will
the Minister of INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether any review was conducted
of the performance of DTH TV channel
launched by Doordarshan;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the State-wise number of viewers and the
amount spent by Doordarshan on the DTH
and the income generated by it since its
launching;
(c) whether Doordarshan is satisfied
with the number of viewers;
(d) if so, the justifications therefor; and
(e) if not, the steps being taken in this
regard?
Lack of public toilets in Metro cities
*276. SHRIMATI JAYA
BACHCHAN: Will the Minister of
URBAN DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the best
practices with regard to public toilets are
missing in the Metro cities of the country;
(b) whether the world standards require
a public convenience after every 1 km.;
(c) if so, the number of public toilets in
each of the metros namely Delhi, Mumbai,
Kolkata and Chennai as compared to 5539
toilets in London for 74 lakh population;
(d) whether the existing toilets are in a
dilapidated state, particularly in Delhi, with
unbearable stench suggesting inadequate
maintenance and unsafe conveniences for
the ladies; and
(e) if so, the action proposed to be taken
in this regard?

at Wajirabad

MISHRA: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
28 children died untimely in the bus
accident on the bridge on Yamuna, very
busy area of Wajirabad in the capital;

announced to make the Wajirabad bridge
double laned but despite the passing of 8th

schools education and distance education

this regard;

Government have resolved to improve this
standard; and
(d) if so, the time limit fixed for this
purpose?
Use of Hindi in courts
*279. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of High Courts
conducting their business in Hindi;
(b) whether there is any phased
programme for the Supreme Court/High
Courts to gradually conduct their judicial
work in Hindi; and
(c) if so, whether Government would,
in consultation with the Chief Justice of
India, lay a time schedule for the same?
Master Plan for UTs

KAUR: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have lately
drawn out a Master Plan 2021 for
Chandigarh, Delhi and other Union
Territories;

commercial and industrial areas and their
proximity and integration with the
residential areas?

Monuments maintenance by ASI in
Tamil Nadu
1957. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN:
SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the monuments
maintained by ASI in Tamil Nadu, district-
wise;
(b) the details of the funds allocated for
each of these during the last three years;
and
(c) the steps taken to develop the major
ones into tourist centre?
Water seepage in Sanchi Stupa
†1958. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
'Sanchi Stupa', included in the world heritage
list, has developed cracks and water is
seeping from many places;
(b) if so, the date since when water has
been seeping from the 'Stupa' as well as
when Government have noticed it;
(c) whether it is a fact that existence of
'Stupa' is in danger as a result of continuous
water seepage; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to save the 'Sanchi Stupa'?

Hindu temples in Pakistan

(a) whether Government have recently
taken any step to help the Government of
Pakistan in rehabilitation and conservation
of the Hindu temples at Katasraj and other
places in that country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the financial assistance, architectural
expertise and other help proposed to be
given to Pakistan for the purpose; and
(c) whether the Government of Pakistan
has given any indication as to when the
work on the proposed projects at various
places there would start and the time likely
to be taken for their completion?

entails locational analysis of the heritage
centres; and

unprotected monuments that are proposed

Minister of CULTURE be pleased to state:

the ASI that Restoration of Muzrai

the non-availability of expected funds;

(c) whether Government of
Maharashtra and Punjab have submitted
any action plan to Government in this
regard; and
(d) if so, the amount Government have
sanctioned/released to each State mentioned
above so far during 2005-06 for
conservation and protected monuments, till
date?

UNESCO for award of such status?

under utilization of 10 per cent of the budget

the non-lapsable pool;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

immigration and other problems

capita amount for its all round
development?

proposal to extend this scheme?

SHRI  SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN

(a) whether it is a fact that in spite of
utilizing 98 per cent of the funds allocated
for Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan during
2004-05, his Ministry has failed to achieve
the physical targets like construction of
schools, classrooms, toilets or recruitment
of teachers;
(b) whether it is also a fact that near

recruited under Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan;

1970. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Minorities

1971. SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
SHRIMATI VANGA
GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that his Ministry
has decided to provide free education to
every single girl child from class VI to XII
in C.B.S.E. affiliated schools;

implemented;

Ministry in this regard?

development

Pradesh

DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:

centres set up in Madhya Pradesh by
Government for the illiterate women;
(b) the number of women benefited there-
from during the last three years, year-wise;
(c) whether these centres have succeeded
in educating and creating awareness
amongst women; and whether Government
are satisfied with their success;
(d) whether Government are contempla-
ting to increase the number of such centres;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

1974. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI K.B. KRISHNA MURTHY:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to bring a new Prevention of Child Marriage
Bill, 2004;
(b) if so, whether Government are aware
that a "Bal Adalat" was organized on the
18th October,2005 where children from
various parts of New Delhi voiced their
concerns and opinions on the proposed
Prevention of Child Marriage Bill, 2004;

incorporated the views expressed by the

up a Commission for appointment of

1978. SHRI MANOJ

SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:

pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have evolved
any proposals to reserve seats for the
minority communities in the IITs, IIMs

(b) whether it is a fact that the Minority
Education Panel has recommended such a
policy to Government;
(c) the details of those recommenda-
tions;
(d) whether the Standing Committee of
his Ministry has recommended reservation

seats for the Minority Communities?

1979. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:

pleased to state:

the other Ministries for better and effective
implementation of the National Plan of
Action for Children , as required under the
plan;
(b) the other Ministries being
coordinated for implementation of the
Action Plan;

purpose?

SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN

Development Programme run by the
IGNOU's distant education has become
popular with the rural masses;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

454
(c) the details of the backward regions
